scenarios.title: Detect a 35% probability crash within 8 seconds
scenarios.event: ETH 5-minute market probability drops from 0.65 to 0.30 in 8 seconds
scenarios.expectedAction: Detect crash signal, log it, execute buy order (or paper trade)

scenarios.title: Paper trade mode logs signal without placing orders
scenarios.expectedAction: Log signal with full details but do not call trading API

scenarios.title: Take profit triggered after price recovery
scenarios.event: Price recovers from crash entry by +$0.10
scenarios.expectedAction: Detect TP condition, place sell order, log profit

scenarios.title: No flash crashes during monitoring period
scenarios.expectedAction: Report zero signals detected, show monitoring statistics

scenarios.title: Stop loss triggered on continued decline
scenarios.event: Price drops further after initial crash buy
scenarios.expectedAction: Detect SL condition, place sell order, log loss, continue monitoring

scenarios.title: Multiple rapid crashes within lookback window
scenarios.expectedAction: Detect first crash, skip second while position is open (max_positions=1)

criteria: Crash detection triggers at correct threshold: Does the skill detect drops >= configured threshold within lookback window?
Paper trade mode works without placing real orders: Does paper mode correctly simulate without API calls?
TP/SL exit conditions evaluated correctly: Does the skill exit positions at configured profit/loss levels?
Statistics tracked accurately: Does the skill maintain correct win rate and P&L running totals?
Rolling price buffer maintained correctly: Does the skill correctly manage the time-windowed price history?
Max position limit enforced: Does the skill prevent opening multiple positions simultaneously?
